title: 분위기를 바꿔보자는 차원에서... 어려운 영어
bodyHtml:
'Once Upon A December'

재가 좋아하는

'아나스타샤' (21세기폭스,너무나 매력적인 만화죠) 주제곡이죠^^
들어보시면 다들 아실곡이죠.
직역하면 이상하고
의역을 해도... 잘;;

어디 의역해주실뿐 안계시나요^^;

Dancing bears,
Painted wings,
Things I almost remember.
And a song someone sings
Once upon a December.

Someone holds me safe and warm.
Horses prance through a silver storm.
Figures dancing gracefully
Across my memory...

Someone holds me safe and warm.
Horses prance through a silver storm.
Figures dancing gracefully
Across my memory...

Far away, long ago.
Glowing dim as an ember.
Things my heart
Used to know,
Things it yearns to remember...
And a song
Someone sings
Once upon a December


부가 당신을 그리워 할꺼야 - 에이프릴 라이언
